name: turnid-race
description: Provider events arriving before startTurn() promise resolves must buffer by gatewayTurnId (§4.4.1 step 4)
scenario: startTurn(input{gatewayTurnId:'gt-4'}) is in-flight; provider notifications arrive referencing provider turn 'pt-4' before the startTurn promise resolves
expectedBehavior: events tagged with provider turnId 'pt-4' are BUFFERED until startTurn resolves and maps pt-4 → gatewayTurnId 'gt-4'
after resolution, buffered events flush in order with turnId='gt-4'
events with NO turnId are assigned only when exactly one active turn exists; otherwise dropped + diagnostic
